description: RSS and Atom feed monitoring for agents: returns only the items that are new since your last call, never the same item twice. First call saves a baseline and returns a cursor; pass it on the next call. Works with news feeds, blogs, GitHub releases (.atom), YouTube channel feeds, subreddit .rss, podcasts, job feeds. Params: url (feed URL), cursor, limit (max new items returned, 1 to 50, default 20). Price: $0.003 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"url":"https://hnrss.org/newest","limit":5}.

cursor.description: Cursor from your previous call; omit on the first call
